title: Make block code viewer scrollable and allow multiple open panels
body:
## Summary

Fixes two regressions/gaps in the merged `@pierre/diffs` code panel and adds multi-open support:

- **Code viewer couldn't scroll**: pierre renders into `diffs-container`'s shadow root, and its scroll region (`code[data-code]`, `overflow: scroll clip`) never engaged because nothing bounded the container→`pre`→`code` chain — the container stretched to full content height (7.7k px) inside the `overflow-hidden` host. `onPostRender` now sizes `diffs-container` to `height: 100%`, and `unsafeCSS` bounds `pre`/`code` and switches `overflow-y` to `auto` so wheel + keyboard scrolling work.
- **Multiple code panels can be open at once**: `codeBlock/codeFiles/codeFile` collapsed into `codeBlocks: Record<blockName, {files, codeFile}>` — toggling one block no longer closes another, each panel tracks its own file selection, and a renderer switch reloads every open panel.

## Upstream and Foldkit evidence

- shadcn/ui source and commit: blocks page multi-panel UX (independent per-block panels)
- Foldkit primitive or example: `codeBlocks` map on `BlocksIndexPage` model; per-block `MountCodeFile` mounts unchanged
- Intentional adaptation: scroll-region CSS fix is injected via pierre's `unsafeCSS`/`onPostRender` hooks (shadow DOM can't be reached from app stylesheets)

## Quality dimensions

- [x] Visual states reviewed in light and dark modes
- [x] Keyboard, focus, and accessible naming verified (scroll regions stay `tabindex=0`)
- [x] Behavior and parent/child message mapping tested (e2e: two panels open, close one, renderer switch reloads both)
- [x] Composition and source ownership remain clear
- [x] Documentation examples and API metadata updated
- [x] Registry dependencies and clean install verified

## Verification

- [x] `npm run check` — green (217 unit + lint caps + build)
- [x] `npm run test:browser` — updated `block code toggle` spec passes locally (multi-open + scroll assertions)
- [x] `npm run test:registry` when registry, dependencies, or generated adapters changed — n/a
- [x] Changelog and parity contracts updated when applicable — n/a
